source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Block anesthesia with 4% articaine, open the marrow, seal without arsenic inactivating agent, and temporarily seal with polycarboxylate.
